question: What result follows when the yogin draws up and places it on the head?
premises: It should be placed on the head.
A future becoming of the yogin is stated.
inference: Therefore by drawing it up and placing it on the head the yogin will attain the intended state.
uncertainties: The object drawn up and the exact state of becoming are implied from context.
plain_english: Having drawn it up, one should place it on the head; then the yogin will become accomplished.
